description: Config for the shared file screener. Screening runs ONLY for the channels listed in Active Channels, and ONLY while the Storage::File::screening toggle is on. Blank scanner fields fall back to code defaults.

fields.label: Allowed Extensions
fields.description: One extension per line, without the dot (pdf, png, jpg, jpeg). An upload whose extension is not listed is refused before its bytes are scanned. Blank = every extension is accepted, which is the default.

fields.label: ClamAV Host
fields.description: clamd host. Blank = clamav (the compose service).

fields.label: If Scanner Unavailable
fields.description: When clamd is unreachable: block (fail-closed, reject the upload) or allow (accept with magic-byte sniff only). Blank = block.

fields.label: Active Channels
fields.description: Screening runs ONLY for the channels listed here. Add a row to activate a channel (Intake, Partner API); remove it to deactivate. Empty = dormant even with the toggle on.

name: CRM File Screening Settings
